title: HIDIVE and MBS Expand Anime Partnership With Multi-Year Exclusive Streaming Deal, Announce Nia Liston: The Merciless Maiden License
content: HIDIVE and Japan’s Mainichi Broadcasting System (MBS) are expanding their anime partnership through a new multi-year output agreement. The agreement will see HIDIVE exclusively simulcast select upcoming MBS anime outside Asia over multiple seasons.

title: Pui Pui Molcar Anime Gets New 5th Anniversary Special
content: The official website for Shinei Animation 's Pui Pui Molcar stop-motion anime series announced on Monday that the franchise is getting a new special to commemorate its fifth anniversary. Creator Tomoki Misato is returning to direct for the franchise for the first time since the anime's first season.

title: Patlabor EZY Anime's Trailer Reveals March 5 Opening, Cast for 'File 3' Movie
content: The official website for the Patlabor EZY anime project began streaming on Monday a teaser trailer for "File 3," the anime's third compilation film containing its seventh and eighth episodes. The video reveals the film's March 5 opening.

title: Reincarnation in the Game World Dankatsu Anime Reveals Teaser, January 2027 Release

A teaser visual and trailer were also revealed, along with the main staff and first voice cast member.
